gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules print sale of assets inside 'Local' receipts, while the statement (p4) prints 'Sale of assets' 219,165 (General 143,918 + Road 75,247) under other financing sources (JSON other_financing). General Fund budget schedule (p8) Local 1,280,213 = General Fund local 1,136,295 (p5) + sale of assets 143,918; Road budget schedule (p10) Local 351,085 = 275,838 + 75,247. Schedule 16,148,162 = printed TOTAL RECEIPTS 15,928,997 + 219,165. No fix.
